acceptance: A new question, access or mapping row finds its use case by the use case ID in its use_case cell, built with the one tracker-tables useCaseId helper and no private copy, so two vendors' same-named use cases are never matched to each other's row. (B3)
A use case ID that matches more than one master row is a conflict, and an unknown ID or a use_case cell in the name or slug-alone form stops the run naming file and line, with nothing written. (B3)
A new use case takes its use_case_name from the proposed field, a wrong or duplicate ID is a conflict, and a new question takes name, reference and vendor from the matched row. (B3)
contract.md holds the merged use case ID matching text, every fixture uses IDs and the new local reference keys, and the tests, the coverage check and the repeat byte-identity test pass. (B3)
